os.path.exists(resultsFileName).note: Models filesystem state: whether the results CSV already exists on disk. False = file absent (benchmark not yet run or output path is new); True = file present (prior run cached results). Both values are needed: False drives the first predicate operand to True; True with ForceRedo=False drives the whole predicate to False.

globalParameters[\"ForceRedoBenchmarkPro.note: Hardcoded default True (GlobalParameters.py:101). Overridable via YAML GlobalParameters section or CLI --global-parameters flag. False = reuse cached results when file exists; True = always rerun benchmark client. Both values needed: True drives predicate to True regardless of file existence; False is required to reach the False branch (file must also exist).
